description: Fetch recent announcements (news items) from your courses in D2L Brightspace. Can filter to a specific course or get announcements across all courses. Use this when the user asks about announcements, news, news items, updates from instructors, recent posts, or what professors said in Brightspace or D2L. Example: "Did my professors post anything new?"

count.description: Maximum number of announcements to return

courseId.description: Course ID to get announcements for. If omitted, returns recent announcements across all courses.

name: get_announcements
title: Get Announcements
